title: test(dogfood): the inbound-mail pool suite reads its fixture sets from the security catalog
body:
Part of #15204
Clause-②: no

## What fails on `main`

`main`'s CI run 38337824333 on `287fd6e5d0`, the first full battery that contains D (#22900, `c8a9783eca`), is red on Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3) in one file:

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/mail-message-pool-read-gate.dogfood.test.ts:111`: `fixture permission set mail_pool_22870_read seeded: expected undefined to be truthy`.

## Why

- #22993 added this suite. Its `grant` helper reads the seeded `sys_permission_set` row of a set declared through `defaultPermissionSets`.
- D removed that seeding (ADR-0131 D3): a set is served by name from the security catalog, and no boot writes its row.
- #22993 landed after T2 (#22898, `07bc34ac05`) moved the dogfood fixtures onto the catalog. PR and queue CI do not run the dogfood shards (#22998), so neither PR ran this file against the other before `main`.

## The change

Test only: one file, 7 lines. It is the hunk S8-T (#22962) carries in this file at `008ca32a75`, byte for byte (blob `adb8b0fa73`):

- `import { catalogPermissionSet } from './catalog-permission-set.js';` (the fixture helper on `main` since T2);
- `grant` asserts the set the security catalog serves, `await catalogPermissionSet(ql, setName)`, instead of a `sys_permission_set` row.

The grant row it writes is unchanged (`permission_set: set.name`). #22962 keeps the same hunk, which merges as a no-op once `main` carries this.

## Verification

Local, through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, on the showcase boot the suite runs (`bootShowcase`), in a worktree whose product source is `main` at `f931e765b7` (built `--filter` closure of the dogfood package, turbo exit 0). The eight `main` commits from `f931e765b7` to this PR's base `121847a7d5` touch none of `packages/qa`, `packages/plugins`, `packages/services/service-mailbox`, `examples`, `packages/objectql`, `packages/rest`, `packages/runtime`, `packages/core` or `packages/metadata-protocol`.

- **Before** (the file as `main` carries it): red, the CI assertion at the same line: `AssertionError: fixture permission set mail_pool_22870_read seeded: expected undefined to be truthy`, frame `grant test/mail-message-pool-read-gate.dogfood.test.ts:111:67`; the suite's 9 tests did not run.
- **After** (this hunk): green, the suite's 9 tests pass (the same file set's run: 279 passed; its one red is `activity-text-predicate`, a 5000 ms timeout under a contended box, untouched here).

The same before/after on a fresh build of this PR's base `121847a7d5` is queued on the shared verify lock; its result goes to the report on #23056.

Gates: the 53 commands `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives for this file; the results and the `--ran` reconciliation are in the report on #23056.

`skip-changeset`: one test file of the private dogfood package; nothing publishes. The relay's `pr_create` takes no labels, so the label is the seat's.
